sources_used: sec-data/cat1-us/10K/2026/MCD_2026-02-24.htm.gz (FY25 systemwide sales, restaurants, comp sales, free cash flow)

kpis.description_fr: Ventes totales aux clients dans tous les restaurants McDonald's mondiaux (franchisés + détenus). Métrique principale du business model franchise (95% des restos). FY25 : 139,4 Mds $, +7% (+5% à devise constante).
kpis.description_en: Total customer sales across all McDonald's restaurants worldwide (franchised + company-owned). Core franchise business model metric (95% franchised). FY25: $139.4B, +7% (+5% constant currency).

kpis.description_fr: Nombre total de restaurants McDonald's mondial fin d'exercice. Déploiement accéléré : ~2300 nouveaux restaurants ouverts en 2025. Cible 50k restaurants 2027 (Accelerating the Arches strategy).
kpis.description_en: Total worldwide McDonald's restaurants at year-end. Accelerated deployment: ~2,300 new restaurants opened in 2025. 50k target by 2027 (Accelerating the Arches strategy).

kpis.description_fr: Revenus consolidés = redevances franchisés + ventes restos détenus + autres. FY25 : 26,9 Mds $ dont 16,5 Mds franchise (+5%) et 9,7 Mds Company-operated (-1%).
kpis.description_en: Consolidated revenues = franchise royalties + Company-owned restaurant sales + other. FY25: $26.9B incl. $16.5B franchised (+5%) and $9.7B Company-operated (-1%).

kpis.description_fr: Marge opérationnelle = résultat opérationnel / revenus consolidés. Niveau exceptionnel sectoriel grâce au modèle franchise asset-light. FY25 : 46,1% (record récent), op income 12,4 Mds $.
kpis.description_en: Operating margin = operating income / consolidated revenues. Best-in-class restaurant sector level thanks to asset-light franchise model. FY25: 46.1% (recent record), operating income $12.4B.

kpis.description_fr: Free Cash Flow = cash from operations - capex. Capex FY25 = 3,4 Mds $ (nouvelles ouvertures + reinvestment). Yann investisseur dividende : 7,1 Mds $ retournés actionnaires (div + buybacks) en 2025.
kpis.description_en: Free Cash Flow = operating cash flow - capex. FY25 capex $3.4B (new openings + reinvestment). $7.1B returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks) in 2025.
